description: API endpoint path.
source: semantic base/user guides/data exchange/swagger.yaml#/paths
derivation: Part of field identity; endpoint plus coalesce(response_field, request_field) is unique in this output.
key_role: field identity component; not unique alone

description: Exact Swagger request parameter name, including headers.
source: semantic base/user guides/data exchange/swagger.yaml#/paths/*/get/parameters/name
derivation: Blank when no such parameter is declared in Swagger. Same-name pairing with a sampled response field is endpoint-local, not a proof of filter behaviour.
key_role: field identity: endpoint plus coalesce(response_field, request_field)

description: Exact response-column name observed in the local samples.
source: data samples/eudamed api actors.csv#header; data samples/eudamed api reference.csv#header; data samples/eudamed api udi.csv#header
derivation: Blank when absent from sample headers; does not prove the API can never return it. At least one of request_field or response_field must be populated.
key_role: field identity: endpoint plus coalesce(response_field, request_field)

description: Swagger parameter location.
source: semantic base/user guides/data exchange/swagger.yaml#/paths/*/get/parameters/in
derivation: Blank exactly when request_field is blank; current catalogue has query/header parameters only.

description: Business meaning or explicitly qualified structural/candidate interpretation.
source: See description_source and mapping_evidence in semantic_base.csv
derivation: Review combines guides, dictionary definitions and computed sample evidence. Subtype and representation differences are retained. A populated description does not imply a resolved mapping.

description: Principal definition source, relative to sources/EUDAMED, with a locator after #.
source: Reviewed local source identified for each semantic_base.csv row
derivation: Additional supporting/conditional sources are recorded in mapping_evidence. pdf-page uses physical pages including cover pages; a dictionary locator is its Field ID.

description: EUDAMED-relative CSV path for one reviewed dictionary candidate.
source: See dictionary_rows() and curated candidates in semantic base/semantic_base_builder.py
derivation: A representative candidate is not universal equivalence: subtype alternatives and parent-to-scalar projections are explained in mapping_evidence. Blank can mean a composite export or no defensible single field.

description: Field ID of the candidate in data_dictionary.
source: Field ID column of the CSV named in data_dictionary
derivation: Path plus Field ID identifies the source record; IDs may recur across sheets. Both dictionary columns are blank or populated together. This is not an API field ID.

description: Raw enum reference attached to the selected candidate dictionary record.
source: ENUM Reference Code column of the CSV named in data_dictionary
derivation: Whitespace collapsed only; may contain multiple references/prose. Neither a complete value list nor a translation to API numeric IDs.

description: Conservative review status covering the recorded interpretation and links.
source: Curated review plus current source/sample checks in semantic base/semantic_base_builder.py
derivation: verified: direct documented API definition with no unverified dictionary link; inferred: supported business meaning or candidate projection/link; unresolved: identity/scope or conflicting evidence remains material. No dictionary crosswalk is currently explicitly verified.

description: Source locators, conditional variants, sample counts and remaining uncertainty.
source: Swagger, dictionaries, cited PDFs and current response samples
derivation: Computed counts describe this snapshot only. Exact-name pairing, format checks and sampled uniqueness do not establish filter semantics, global keys, persistence or universal cardinality.

description: Endpoint whose field has this value.
source: semantic base/semantic_base.csv#endpoint
derivation: Join to endpoint plus field; value rows are evidence, not a complete allowed-value dimension.
key_role: field identity component; not unique alone

description: Canonical API field name: response_field when present, otherwise request_field.
source: semantic base/semantic_base.csv#request_field,response_field
derivation: Join using endpoint and coalesce(response_field, request_field); not unique alone.
key_role: field identity component; foreign key with endpoint

description: Exact observed value, reference ID, enumeration code or documented request option.
source: Source named by source and source_locator
derivation: All values remain strings; NULL sample markers and empty cells are excluded; list-like export strings are not split.

description: Source-provided display label where available.
source: data samples/eudamed api reference.csv#VALUE; semantic base/technical documentation/data dictionaries/EMDN/EMDN v2026_EN.csv#TERM EMDN (v.2026); source/source_locator for PDF entries
derivation: Blank where a source provides no label; dictionary code labels are kept separate from API numeric-ID labels. No numeric-ID translations are invented.

description: Source language of the label, preserved where supplied.
source: data samples/eudamed api reference.csv#LANGUAGE; English version of EMDN and cited PDF pages
derivation: Blank if no label language is specified; reference languages are preserved without substituting English for missing translations.

description: Evidence class for this value.
source: Source type and reviewed lists in semantic base/semantic_base_builder.py
derivation: allowed means explicitly listed at value_scope, not necessarily exhaustive; reference-listed is a catalogue entry, not an acceptance test; observed means a whole nonmissing sample cell.

description: Representation to which the source value applies.
source: Reviewed source context
derivation: dictionary values are candidate submission representations, not verified API IDs/inputs; request_response qualifies an API reference ID for a request field also observed in the response. Always retain main-row mapping qualifications.

description: EUDAMED-relative source file path.
source: Local source snapshot
derivation: Source provenance, not a claim of completeness or freshness.

description: Column, reference key, PDF page/enum or EMDN version locating the evidence.
source: Source-specific identifiers
derivation: Reference IDs are qualified by CODE and LANGUAGE.

description: Known source extraction/publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
source: Explicit full source date only
derivation: Blank in current undated snapshots; year/version or filesystem/build timestamps are not substituted. Logical date type, serialized as ISO text when known.
